references.title: Add Students modal with manual and CSV paths
references.question: Q4
references.take: Teachable puts manual entry and Import CSV in one Add Students modal, keeping the bulk path adjacent to the quick path.

references.title: Student add form with course enrollment option
references.question: Q1
references.take: The add-student form combines identity fields with an enrollment choice, a useful seam for attaching a selected learner group to a course.

references.title: Students management list with enrollment feedback
references.question: Q3
references.take: Teachable returns the instructor to a dedicated Students list after adding, making roster state and confirmation visible in the management context.

references.title: Project access and collaborator list
references.question: Q2
references.take: Linear keeps the project’s existing access list visible in the invite surface, giving the admin a review point before confirming who gains access.

references.title: Sent invitation tracking view
references.question: Q6
references.take: Slack exposes sent invitations as a trackable state, suggesting enrollment notifications need a visible pending or delivered seam rather than disappearing after confirmation.

references.title: Set maximum capacity dialog
references.question: Q5
references.take: Event-registration analogy: Max Capacity states registration closes at the limit and exposes an Over-Capacity Waitlist toggle. Group admission and promotion rules are not shown.

references.title: Email invites with bulk entry and recipient review
references.question: Q4
references.take: Event-invitation analogy: Add Manually/Bulk Add, CSV template and Name/Email headers, recipient review, a message and Send emails share one modal. This does not prove course enrollment or delivery.

references.title: CSV import review and mapping step
references.question: Q2
references.take: 1Password inserts a structured review and mapping step between CSV upload and commit, giving admins a place to resolve row-level conflicts before impact is applied.
